# C2SP age test vectors (CCTV)

A copy of `age/testdata` from [C2SP/CCTV](https://github.com/C2SP/CCTV/tree/b88c4b206254ac543df240097e0f1fcc6a664821/age),
commit `b88c4b206254ac543df240097e0f1fcc6a664821` (1 November 2026). Licence: `0BSD OR CC0-1.0 OR Unlicense`.

`test/age.test.js` runs every vector against `lib/age.js`. The format is described in the
[CCTV age README](https://github.com/C2SP/CCTV/blob/b88c4b206254ac543df240097e0f1fcc6a664821/age/README.md).
Do not edit these files; update them by copying a newer commit and recording it here.
